parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the domain name group.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

Default value: en.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns add-domain-group --lang en --group-name MyGroup --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns AddDomainGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName MyGroup --Lang en
